name: hope-capital-newspaper-windchime
reviewNotes: All 14 records visually reviewed against original-ROM glyph renders and checked against source bytes. Draft only; no ROM or manifest changes.

The source restaurant sign is 料亭い志ゐ, rendered 志井料亭. The source temple name is written in kana as しょじょ寺. 證城寺 is a consistent provisional Traditional Chinese rendering shared with taketori-refugees, not a verified kanji equivalence.

Preserve the newspaper's 68-year-old wind-chime collector, 100-ryo sale, fish buyback, northern route, Narabi Jizo directions and carpenter Tome's relocation advice. Dynamic [09] is retained and width-tested as a five-glyph name.
